(module scope)

The description record — components.animations..

record

Reads one animation record from the live-then-fallback components dictionary. Unknown ids yield empty strings — applying them is a no-op, so callers never need a pre-check.

  • @param id ANIMATION_IDS entry.
  • @returns {alt, longdesc} — possibly empty strings.

animationAlt

The one-sentence animation label — the alt/aria-label source.

  • @param id ANIMATION_IDS entry.
  • @returns The localized alt text, or ''.

animationLongDesc

The full animation description — element, behavior, triggers, tech and purpose in one paragraph.

  • @param id ANIMATION_IDS entry.
  • @returns The localized longdesc text, or ''.

ensureImgRole

Ensures the element carries role="img" so an applied aria-label is legal on a generic host — an author-provided role is never overwritten. Shared by the canvas and generic-element branches.

  • @param el The animated element.

ensureDescNode

Finds-or-creates the longdesc node inside root and refreshes its text — locale switches land as text updates on the same node, so aria-describedby refs never dangle. The node anchors as the element's own sibling so it inherits whatever landmark wraps the element: a loose span at the root is page content outside every landmark, which axe's region rule flags. Elements with no element parent (detached or direct shadow-root children) and document-level surfaces (the body, whose <html> parent can't take a sibling) fall back to the root / <main> / body hosts.

  • @param root The element's root (ShadowRoot for the closed DOM tree,
  • @param id ANIMATION_IDS entry.
  • @param text The longdesc text to store.
  • @param el The animated element — sibling anchor for the node.
  • @returns The desc node id the caller points at, or '' when the text

applyAnimationDesc

Binds an animated element to its translated description — sets the accessible name (alt/aria-label), aria-describedby (+ longdesc on imgs, fallback content on canvases) pointing at a hidden desc node injected into the element's own root.

Safe to call on every mount/locale-change: the desc node is created once per (root, id) and only re-texted afterwards. Elements without a resolvable description are left untouched.

  • @param el The animated element (any Element — canvas, img, div, button…).
  • @param id ANIMATION_IDS entry naming its animation.
